name: mirage
text: Cause (from the code): the Bet button only shows while THIS phone holds the Vigilant subaccount's trading key. If it is gone, the phone no longer has that key. The usual ways: the key was replaced or revoked from another device (Novig allows one trading key per subaccount, so Enable betting on the tablet, or Send trading key to GitHub which makes a new one, revokes the phone's), or the app's saved copy was cleared. Fix: on this phone open Settings › Betting & Novig account and tap Enable betting; if it says the key was revoked, then on the device that holds the current key use Settings › Usage & keys › Save trading key, and here 'Use the trading key' (shares one key between phone and tablet without revoking). The engine on GitHub is not affected and is still ordering. Tell me what Settings › Betting & Novig account says and I will take it from there.
